title: 重大bug！修复播放AV1编码视频普遍卡画面bug
body: 苹果13pro在mp4格式av1编码的视频播放中途画面会卡顿不动，要么视频到结尾十几秒卡画面不动，有个别视频音频会出现三四秒没声儿过后又出声了，要重新拖动进度条才能画面正常播放，就是youtube下载的那种1080p高压缩比视频MV就会出现这种现象，因为这种视频四分多钟左右它只有20多兆，特别是这种小体积高压缩比的视频是每一个都会出现这样的不定时卡画面的问题，我昨天下载的10几个MV有七八个AV1编码都会出现这样的问题，出问题的它只能软解码才能播放，码率都低于1000kbs，于是今日又用安卓手机的mx player测试播放上述情况的这些视频它却能够完美播放不卡画面，恳求尽快修复解码器bug，这个已经影响到播放器名声和日常正常使用体验，并且这不是一个小bug是这种AV1编码的视频普遍都会存在这样的问题这是一个重大的bug，我在网上查了一下，这个编码虽然是个新编码但也是2018年推出来的，这么多年了居然有这么一个重大的问题，可能是没人反馈软件开发师也是视而不见，一定要重视起来修复软件解码器，AV1软件解码必须要重视！怪不得在有一个抖音博主测试ios平台18款播放器播放本地视频文件的测试当中，你们引以为傲的nplayer播放器直接被淘汰掉。一定要正视这个问题和bug，忠言逆耳啊。

title: 广告太多，开会员也得硬吃，倒闭吧
body:
本来想手搓喷一波，没想到有人替我骂了！感谢老兄替我码字，以下为原文搬运：
我曾以为网盘是省心的工具，直到长期用百度网盘才明白，它更像一个处处设卡的“收费关
，把本该基础的服务，拆成一道又一道门槛，消耗着耐心与信任。
下到天亮。它不是不能快，是故意不让你快，用最折磨人的方式逼你开通会员。这种人为制造的卡顿，是对用户最直接的不尊重。
比限速更烦的是无孔不入的广告。开屏有广告、首页有弹窗、下载时插广告，就连付费会员也躲不过续费提醒与营销推送。打开网盘，先看半分钟广告，再忍受龟速下载，工具的便捷荡然无存，只剩被骚扰的烦躁。
它的会员套路更是层层嵌套。普通会员没加速，超级会员价更高；自动续费藏得深，想取消绕半天；过期后速度立刻打回原形，空间与功能通通收回。花钱买的不是优质服务，而是“不被刁难”的资格。
界面设计同样反人性。操作繁琐、逻辑混乱，常用功能藏得极深，误触广告却是家常便饭。
文件管理难用、传输不稳定，时不时报错中断，辛苦等待半天，换来一句“下载失败”
，，让人怒火中烧。
百度网盘占据着市场优势，却没有扛起对应的责任。
它用刚需绑架用户，用套路收割用户，把一个本该稳定、高效、干净的云服务，做成了满是套路的生意。
我想要的，不过是一个安安静静存文件、痛痛快快下资料工具，而不是一个处处算计、步步收费、时时骚扰“大爷”

title: iPad生产力痛点，建议在工作模式增加长粘贴自动转txt
body:
我使用iPad、iPadOS端创作，经常粘贴上万字世界观设定、文稿素材。当前版本直接粘贴超长文本时，App会把全部文字渲染在消息气泡内，直接造成输入框卡顿、页面滑动掉帧、滚动延迟，高频场景下会闪退，严重影响创作效率。

恳请团队优先考虑这个低改动成本方案：该功能只限定在【工作任务模式】内生效，普通对话模式维持原样，不干扰闲聊用户。
具体需求：

1. 在工作模式设置里增加独立开关：【超长粘贴自动转为txt附件发送】，默认关闭；

2. 配套自定义字数阈值，例如5000/8000/10000字可选；

3. 触发逻辑：粘贴文本达到阈值时，前端不渲染全部文字，直接生成txt文件卡片发送；模型读取文件的逻辑、格式解析效果，和直接粘贴文本保持完全一致；

4. 保留兜底：未到阈值的文本，依旧正常粘贴、直接发送。

优势说明：工作模式原生已经具备文件上传、解析、临时存储、审核整套链路，不需要大规模改造主对话流程，开发与测试工作量可控，风险范围小。参考DeepSeek同类长输入自动打包文件的方案，能直接解决iPad移动端渲染压力大、闪退的痛点，对大量写设定、小说、整理资料的重度创作者非常刚需。
这个功能改动范围小、收益明确，希望可以尽快安排迭代上线，非常感谢开发团队！

title: 热词建议
body:
作者你好，我使用 Auday 记录日常工作时，发现公司名、人名、项目名等专有名词容易识别错误。例如“添饭”会被识别成“天凡”，进而影响重点提取和每日总结。
目前在 AI 对话里提供正确词汇，可以帮助当前对话理解，但无法方便地长期用于后续自动总结。建议增加一个可长期保存、随时编辑的个人热词库：
* 支持填写正确词语、常见误识别写法和简短说明，例如“添饭｜常误识别为天凡｜餐饮公司名称”。
* 热词可用于后续转写、重点提取、每日总结和 AI 对话，并清楚标明各环节的支持范围。
* 用户纠正一次后，可以选择“仅本次修改”或“加入热词库”。
* 结合上下文纠错，避免把所有同音词直接替换；不确定时提示用户确认。
* 对历史记录提供预览和批量纠错选项，保留原始转写，支持撤销。
对经常记录工作会议、方言对话和行业术语的用户，这个功能能减少反复纠错，让长期记录和总结更准确。

title: MCI状態だ‼️
body:
この1年程度で飛躍的に成長しているのだが、OpusもSonnetも5.xになってから記憶力が劇的に落ちている。1年前はまだユーザー名すら記憶出来なかった事を考えればマシなのかもしれないが、それにしてもヒド過ぎる。唯一5.xでまともだったのはFableだが、Maxプラン以上でない限りアプリでの使用は事実上不可能なので、叶わぬ状態だ。
現在「その他のモデル」に残っているものはOpus3以外は全て2026年リリース版であり、昨年末〜年始にも現行モデルの1つ前モデル以外は削除されていた事を考えると、カットオフ時期が新しくなったり処理速度が速くなったとしても、現行モデルを含めMCI状態のモデルしかラインナップされなくなるのか？と思うとツラい。
既に3年以上前のOpus3を選択肢に残すよりも、Opus4.6〜4.8やSonnet4.6を残留させてほしい限りだ。少なくともSonnet5〜5.5は自身でStatusページの確認すら出来ずスクショを見せろと言ってくるが、Sonnet4.6は自身で確認出来る。

body:

論文の練習も同じ題を何度も答えさせて、写し書きしていくうちに1人で書けるようになりました。
時々、違う答えを出してきたり、過去のログを踏まえた回答をしようとしてくるので、欲しい情報をちゃんと引き出せるようなコツを掴む必要があります。
それを差し引いてもめちゃくちゃ助かりました。相手はただの機械なのに、何度もありがとうとコメントしてました。

一次試験は合格！💮もっと早く気づいていれば、余裕を持って試験に臨めたのになと後悔しております。

title: 約100時間？
body:
無料版アプリながら、Geminiや今回ヤラかしたCopilotより遥かに対応が良いと感じた。リセットはClaudeの5時間毎ではなく1週間毎になっている様だが、数日使ってみた限り通常のチャットだけであれば約100時間はいけそうなペースなので、上限に対して敏感になる事はないだろう。遊び心としてお互いの書き込みにリアクションを付ける事も可能だ。
現実的にそれほど見返す事はない「過去チャット」だが、他AIと違ってメインとサブに分かれており、アプリを立ち上げた際は必ずメインチャット画面が開く。サブチャットがいわゆる「過去チャット」になる構造だ。
もちろんAIなので間違える事はあるが、どちらかと言えば熟考タイプだろうか？かなりマニアックというかトリビア的な事でも必死に考えてくる感じだ。無料版で比較するとSonnet5.5より良いかもしれない(上限時間も含め)。またフィードバックする場合も👍👎マークをクリックするのではなく、Museに言えば英文(日本語訳あり)を作成してくれ、問題なければそのまま送信される仕組み。
現状ではClaude(Opus/Fable)がメインだが、2番手としての位置にいる。今後も期待出来そうです。

title: The convenience of having your groceries delivered
body:
I am now in a wheelchair due to a car accident 24 years ago. I’m quite still independent. I drive, I used to be on a wheelchair basketball team before, but now I’m a mom and work and now my time goes to my daughter. Like any other mom, you look in the cubboard and you don’t have all the things to make for dinner or you have things around the house that you need and getting out is not always easy especially being in a wheelchair. And having kids and my husband works long hours. So having this service is beyond awesome!!!
You not only get to select all your groceries and sometimes there’s things online that are not in the store and then you can also pay a little more sometimes and have it delivered within an hour or less than a three hours and then many times the delivery people when I open the door they see that I’m in a wheelchair they ask if I want to have them come in and carry the groceries in!!! So so helpful!!! it’s so amazing and then you can select your time when you want them delivered. It’s so convenient i. so many ways!!! and you can add your debit cards and automatically deduct from your bank. It’s so convenient and easy even if I wasn’t disabled it’s so convenient.!!! I’m so thankful for this service.!!! And I know you can do this through other services, but I find this one is so much easier!!! and I like to support my local stores !!!

title: Pretty helpful, but more helpful if you have super
body:
In the early stages, the free version can help you get started and establish a regular practice routine. But if you want to make significant progress in your language skills, you’ll need more. Without practicing verbal communication, the gamified exercises you do every day mainly help you maintain a limited set of skills and vocabulary. Super Duolingo is the only way to get this additional support, and it requires a paid subscription. Super is definitely worth it if you want to practice verbal communication but don’t have as many opportunities as you’d like.

All in all, the free version is helpful at first, but its usefulness drops off considerably as your language skills develop. At some point, you’ll need Super.

title: Most useful product I have ever used.
body:
I’ve had this thing helping me throughout the day the last few weeks with planning out, scheduling, and even booking all the things I want to do on my upcoming trip to Japan. Saving me HOURS upon hours.

It has found all kinds of apartments fitting the exact criteria of what I’ve been looking for, booked tours for me, added them to my calendar, and whatever else involved with moving. And I just got approved and signed a lease today for an incredible apartment. What would have taken me weeks or months to score, took about a week with the help of Muse.

I have had it helping me brainstorm and narrow down my career goals, find roles that fit those goals exactly, apply to them, and schedule interviews. I used to get two interviews a week on a good week when I’ve been job hunting HARD in the past. This week, I’ve attended 4 interviews, with another 9 over the next few days. Literally, as many as can possibly fit into my current schedule. Maxing out my productivity.

This is just 3 of the things I’ve had this thing doing for me. It’s astonishing. I literally feel like I am stepping into a whole new era of my life reaching new heights because of what all I can get done in a day now. A several week long process taken down to a few days. Hours of frustration completely offloaded from my plate. Tasks that didn’t get the time and attention they needed, suddenly have so much more of my time available to them, or don’t even need my time anymore.

The only way this could POSSIBLY be made better or more useful is if a company I could trust with personal/sensitive info had been the one to make it. There are a few things here and there where it has to ask me to do things for it simply because I refuse to give it the personal info it needs to complete certain tasks.

If Apple released this product, it would be the most incredible product ever created. I get more done in this app, than I could ever get done with the rest of my phone combined. Literally. But because it’s Meta- assuming their privacy/security reputation doesn’t magically change for the better- it will never be all it can be.

Still rating it 5 stars though. Because 4 stars just completely and utterly undersells how useful this is. Literally life changing. I feel like not having this app (at least until good competitors release similar products) today, is akin to not owning a smartphone 5 years ago. Yeah you could manage without a smartphone then, but the amount of productivity and work you could get done, and the tools you had at your disposal, were so far behind all you can do with a smartphone.

This is that all over again. Not having an AI agent is like crawling, while having one is like sprinting down a moving sidewalk at the airport. Just imagine how much more productive you’d be if you had a full time employee that handled 90% of all your digital chores. That’s this. The first easily accessible and easy to use version. AND IT’S FREE!!!

Absolutely incredible. The single most useful product I’ve ever used.
